historical_exclusions.limitation: Identity exclusions cover the named frozen VFARL/P015 inventories and available P017 run manifests; this is not proof that every historical research artifact has been enumerated.

selection_policy.rule: One new repair family per declared repository; reuse an existing nonstock Linux profile; historical thinking=0 maximum length <=6144 and closest to4500, then seeded SHA256 tie break. No new model rewards used.

linux_environment_profiles.reuse: Existing frozen profile directories only; no new packages requested
linux_environment_profiles.new_task_acceptance: Every selected task still needs real Linux baseline/repaired official verification

research_split.validation_use: Before/after original rollouts only; no focal sampling, rewards, gradients or adaptive task selection
research_split.limitation: All16 belong to the previously prepared S600 demonstration course. Research probes are new to this VFARL round, not an official heldout benchmark or proof of never-seen pretraining/SFT data.

metadata_boundary: Only official_initial_user_prompt enters the policy. Selection/source links/reference patches/verifier assets remain judge-side.

tasks.repair_family_id: funcy::update_in::Persistent recursive path update and dictionary auto-vivification
pyparsing::Dict.postParse::Dictionary grammar conversion should expose grouped key/value rows as their original named entries without destroying row structure
